decision: Is Gaia Steward the final integration authority for registered routine and automated pull requests, with narrowly scoped, policy-gated merge and closure routes (forge.merge_pr, forge.close_pr) and GitHub receipts?
whyItMatters: This is new external-write authority: merging into the protected destination branch and closing pull requests. The prior prohibition on merging into main is amended only for this route. Global protections stay: no direct push to main, no force-merge, no fabricated approvals, no bypass of required checks, no squash merge, no widening by a stronger model.
evidence: Decided by: founder (Marco Tiongson), session directive 2026-11-04.
Founder directive, verbatim: "Gaia Steward is the designated final integration authority for eligible automated and recurring-routine pull requests across the Gaia Research ecosystem."

Founder directive, verbatim: "The founder authorizes the new narrowly scoped Steward-controlled merge and closure routes. This does not authorize bypassing existing protected-branch rules, explicit human approvals, or unrelated release gates."
Founder directive, verbatim: "Implement its authority as a narrowly scoped policy capability, never a blanket permission for Steward to merge arbitrary PRs."

Founder directive, verbatim: "There is no additional founder approval required merely because an otherwise eligible routine PR is being merged by Steward. When a real founder decision is required, use Class C."

Founder scope narrowing, 2026-11-04 (same session): "lets not add gaia skill heaven for now, steward only observes skill tree first. skill heaven deferred". Enabled scope is gaia-research/gaia-skill-tree only; gaia-skill-heaven and organisation-wide discovery are deferred and reported as unknown, never healthy.

Live activation conditions in the directive: policy route implemented; tests and adversarial gates pass; independent verification passes; the PR family has established eligibility; existing required human approvals are satisfied; the GitHub operation is permitted by branch protection.

POLICY.yaml section prMaintenance pins ceilings in code (maxMergesPerRun and maxClosuresPerRun at most 5, hourlyWriteCap at most 25, squash not representable). A switch edit alone grants nothing; this decided record is also required, and a kill switch revokes the route at any time.
recommended: Approved as directed. Steward may merge or close a registered routine pull request only through forge.merge_pr / forge.close_pr after the gate re-proves producer eligibility, exact head SHA, state, reviews, checks, file scope, supersession, independent verification, policy revision, branch protection, kill switch and prior execution.
alternative: Keep routine pull-request merges human-performed and retain the sensor as read-only context.
unblocks: Routine 19 (PR maintenance): eligible recurring bot pull requests are merged and provably superseded ones are closed, each with GitHub receipts. Class C items go to the founder desk without blocking unrelated work.
